title: l'Arabesque (25 Etudes faciles, Op. 100, No. 2)
subtitle: Arabeske
trains: Quick 16th-note turn figures answered by a light eighth-note tag, alternating with a lyrical dotted-quarter melody, over a steady broken-chord left hand in A minor - finger agility and voicing a short melodic cell cleanly at a scherzando tempo.

provenance.credit: Typeset by Bas Wassink for the Mutopia Project
